entries.zh: 肃静、庄重场合的肃穆安静；使安静、平定（动词义）
entries.en: solemnly quiet, still, hushed; to quiet, to calm (cf. quietar)
entries.notes: 词头兼有 Quieto/Quietā 两形（后者或为 quietā(r) 缩写），闽南语栏并列两种读音且末一音 jiēng 标[疑]；词义据汉字"肃静"与西语 quieto 可定，读音归属存疑。

entries.zh: 舒适自在、无所苦痛；宽松从容
entries.en: at ease, comfortable, free from pain or distress

entries.zh: 安分体面（据西语词头推断；汉字"料"此义项不明）
entries.en: quiet, respectable; sense inferred from the Spanish headword, the character 料 does not clearly carry this sense
entries.notes: 汉字"料"单独对应 quieto/honrrado 之义项不直观，且闽南语声调 liâu/liāu 标[疑]，语义无法定夺，仅按西语词头姑译待复核。

entries.zh: 安分、安于本分；平静无事
entries.en: settled, keeping one's place; quiet, at peace
entries.notes: M 栏另记一音 va（原稿无[疑]标记，或为别读），词义据汉字"安"与词头 quieto honrrado 无碍。

entries.zh: 禅定、静虑；寂静（以佛家禅寂义释 quieto）
entries.en: meditative stillness, quietude; quiet
peaceful and well; moderate, mild
entries.notes: 西语词头 moderado 处标[疑]；汉字"康"取安康、温和义与 quieto y pacifico 相合，词头后半存疑。

entries.en: still, silent; solitary
entries.notes: 闽南语读音栏 T99 污损难辨且标[疑]，音写不可据；词义据汉字"寂"与西语 quieto 尚可定。

entries.zh: 平静、安稳（西语词头后半残损难辨）
entries.en: calm, tranquil (tail of the Spanish headword illegible)
entries.notes: 西语词头 y elg nomukennado 不可辨，闽南语栏残缺（[残]ju xo [疑]）且有 T99；词义仅据汉字"平静"与残存词头 quieto honrrado。

entries.zh: 平和公允、不偏不倚；性情平和
entries.en: even-tempered and fair, impartial
entries.notes: 闽南语读音 pēng in 标[疑]；汉字"平允"（平和公正）与词头 quieto 之"平和"义相合，读音存疑。

entries.en: safe and sound, peaceful, untroubled
peaceful, tranquil; (of the times) free from disorder
entries.notes: M 栏串入词头 y pacifico，系原稿渗写，不影响释义。

entries.en: secure, stable, safe and steady
entries.notes: 闽南语第二读音 va/ũa 标[疑]（疑为"安"别读之辨），汉字"安稳"义明确。

entries.en: at ease and happy, free from trouble
health and tranquility, well-being
hale and well, in good health and ease
to keep to one's own station and duty, stay within one's place
hale and healthy, in good health

entries.zh: 舒畅、宽畅无郁（首音写残缺）
entries.en: relaxed and cheerful, free from care
entries.notes: 闽南语栏残缺（chū[残]）且并列多种读音、有 T99 与[疑]；词义据汉字"舒畅"与词头 quieto sin pena 可定。

entries.en: relieved of care, open-hearted, at ease

entries.zh: 安逸、闲适安稳（首字残缺）
entries.en: at ease, comfortable, in quiet leisure
entries.notes: 闽南语栏首字残缺（[残]ān it [疑]）且有 T99；词义据汉字"安逸"与词头 quieto sosegado 可定。

entries.en: quiet, tranquil, undisturbed
peace, peaceful, harmonious
entries.notes: 闽南语第二写法 ℓChy 标[疑]不可解；汉字"和平"与词头 quieto 义合。
